data.title: Initial Level Placement
data.description: A high-level scan to establish your current CEFR baseline (A2-B2).

sections.explain: The past simple of 'go' is 'went'. 'Gone' is the past participle.

words.word: Last night, I went to the cinema.
Last night, I gone to the cinema.
Last night, I was go to the cinema.

sections.explain: 'Their' is used for possession. 'There' is a place; 'They're' is 'they are'.

words.word: The children left their bags at school.
The children left there bags at school.
The children left they're bags at school.

sections.explain: Third-person singular (he/she/it) requires an 's' on the verb.

words.word: She works in a bank in London.
She work in a bank in London.
She is work in a bank in London.

sections.explain: Use 'for' for a period of time (duration) and 'since' for a point in time.

words.word: I have lived in this city for five years.
I have lived in this city since five years.
I live in this city for five years.

sections.explain: 'Managed to' describes succeeding in a specific, difficult past task.

words.word: The test was hard, but I managed to pass.
The test was hard, but I could to pass.
The test was hard, but I was able pass.
Tokyo is more expensive than Berlin.
Tokyo is expensiver than Berlin.
Tokyo is most expensive than Berlin.

sections.explain: 'Although' connects two contrasting clauses within one sentence.

words.word: Although it was cold, we went swimming.
Despite it was cold, we went swimming.
However it was cold, we went swimming.

sections.explain: For hypothetical 'unreal' states, use 'were' for all subjects (I/He/She).

words.word: If I were you, I would take the job.
If I was you, I would take the job.
If I am you, I will take the job.

sections.explain: Structure: Subject + is said + to have + past participle.

words.word: He is said to have escaped the prison.
He is said he escaped the prison.
He said to have escaped the prison.

sections.explain: Limiting adverbs (Never/Rarely) at the start require auxiliary inversion.

words.word: Never have I seen such a huge building.
Never I have seen such a huge building.
Never have I see such a huge building.
